summaryMarkdown:
Tom and the user reviewed pilot results, discussed pricing for 200 seats, and agreed on a rollout plan starting with the billing team in December.

### Pilot Results
- Pilot ran for six weeks with 40 agents.
- Average handle time dropped from 9 minutes to 6.5 minutes.
- Customer satisfaction increased from 81% to 88%.
- Biggest gain was on billing questions.

### Pricing
- List price is $30 per seat per month.
- For 200 seats on an annual contract, price is $24 per seat per month.
- Total cost is about $57,600 per year.

### Security Requirements
- Security team needs SOC 2 report and data processing agreement before legal will sign.
- Tom can send SOC-2 Type 2 report today.
- Legal team will share data processing agreement by Wednesday.

### Rollout Plan
- Start with billing team in December, then add support team in January.
- Two training sessions for billing team in first week of December.
